description: Review of the commit that added the exhaustive binding map and normalised aliases: `class TestA[pytest]:` (PEP 695) binds `pytest` as a type parameter in an annotation scope that the class's methods see, so `pytest.skip()` in `test_adds` is the type variable's attribute, not pytest's (it raises AttributeError). TG003 warns that it may skip the test, never FAIL; the real runner runs it (it fails).
